title: Develop a feature without regressions
description: Inspect repository instructions, architecture, scripts and local changes first.
prompt:
Act as a senior software engineer.

Task: Develop a feature without regressions.

Input context:
- FEATURE: [FEATURE]
- REPOSITORY: [REPOSITORY]
- ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: [ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA]

Inspect repository instructions, architecture, scripts and local changes first. Propose the smallest compatible implementation. Preserve existing behaviour and data, add relevant tests and distinguish executed checks from proposed ones. Summarise changes and remaining risks; do not deploy without approval.

Preserve existing work and data. Define acceptance criteria and relevant checks. Separate plans, simulations and executed actions. No deployment without approval.

Use English for explanations unless the task or user explicitly requires another language. Use clear sections and a format suited to the deliverable. If essential information is missing, ask a focused question before concluding. Label assumptions and unknowns. Do not invent facts, sources, results or completed checks. End with verification criteria and remaining limitations.
exampleResult:
## Local favourites implementation plan
Add a guarded storage module, an accessible toggle and a saved-only filter without rebuilding the catalogue. Test invalid storage, missing permissions and removal of the last favourite. Run the existing checks after implementation. This is an illustrative plan: no repository has been modified or test execution established by the example.
useCases: Prepare a reviewable deliverable: develop a feature without regressions.
Compare assumptions, evidence and practical next steps before taking action.
tips: Provide concrete, authorised context for feature before using this prompt.

originalPrompt: Tu interviens dans un dépôt existant pour ajouter [FONCTIONNALITE]. Inspecte d’abord les instructions du dépôt, l’architecture, les scripts et les changements locaux. Préserve les modifications existantes. Propose le plus petit changement cohérent, puis implémente-le si tes outils et autorisations le permettent. Ajoute des tests sur [CAS_CRITIQUES]. N’installe pas de dépendances et ne déploie pas sans accord. N’affirme jamais avoir exécuté une commande qui ne l’a pas été. Rapporte fichiers modifiés, vérifications réellement exécutées et limites.
